prompts.A:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create an actual refined character turnaround and expression study sheet for the existing original Nunti mascot in reference image 1. Reference image 1 is the fixed identity source, particularly its LARGE TOP CHARACTER. This is a careful design refinement of THAT SAME CHARACTER.
INVARIANTS: preserve its round oversized ivory hood and compact two-armed two-legged baby body, exactly two short mint sprout lobes on top, asymmetric single cream forelock curl, large brown oval eyes with the SAME face-relative size, centers, spacing and outlines, tiny nose, signature small warm open smile shape, mint scarf tied on the character's LEFT (viewer's right in front view), mint cross-body satchel resting on the character's RIGHT hip (viewer's left), strap going over its left shoulder, light mist-blue trousers and mint/ivory simple shoes, blue four-point badge with a white winding route mark on the character's LEFT chest. Keep asymmetry attached to anatomical sides across views. No species change, animal ears, extra hat, limb changes, new decorations, different mascot or famous character imitation.
OUTPUT: one high-resolution square professional character model sheet, ivory-white uniform background, very clean editorial layout, generous whitespace, no border, no busy decor, no environmental scene. At top a small heading and three evenly spaced large full-body neutral-pose turnarounds with hands relaxed, SAME height and eye level. Left FRONT (0 degrees), middle 3/4 (45 degrees), right SIDE (true 90-degree profile facing screen right, one eye visible). Every sprout and foot fully inside its cell. This is the SAME figure turned, no costume changes. In the bottom half, precisely SEVEN separate matching head-and-shoulders portraits in two rows, four in first row and three in second row. Each portrait includes the complete hood, sprout, curl, and scarf. Order and subtle English labels: BASE, CALM, CURIOUS, CONCERNED, SURPRISED, RELIEVED, JOYFUL. BASE has open eyes and small friendly smile; CALM relaxed closed lids and closed soft smile; CURIOUS open eyes within original bounds, one brow gently raised and small attentive smile; CONCERNED inner brows slightly raised, small worried mouth, no tears; SURPRISED raised brows and small round open mouth; RELIEVED soft closed smile eyes and gentle exhale mouth WITHOUT floating symbols; JOYFUL smiling crescent eyes and open signature mouth. Distinguish calm, relief and joy by brow/mouth treatment. Fixed eye centers and eye scale, varied eyelids only. Do NOT attach emotion icons, hearts, sweat drops or words to the character. No extra eighth portrait. Label each portrait legibly below it. Labels are separate from artwork. At the very bottom, five small palette swatches. Exact title and direction follow.
All output is a review CONCEPT, raster illustration, clean enough to assess at small scale. Keep baseline proportions close to the source, simplify detail instead of changing the face.
DIRECTION A. Title "NUNTI / A — MATTE FORM". A restrained premium soft-matte sculpted character with smooth opaque ivory surfaces, shallow rounded 2.5D volume, soft diffuse light, restrained blush. Remove knitted microtexture, busy seams, tiny shoe laces, fabric wrinkles, zipper and buckle detail. Keep bag, scarf and badge as simple readable shapes. Eyes retain the rich brown irises but use one clear catchlight and simplified smooth shading rather than multiple glossy reflections. Thin seams only where needed. Body has subtle volume, no hard plastic sheen, no photoreal skin, no fuzzy material, no heavy black outlines. Quiet ivory, soft mint, mist blue, warm peach, and deep cocoa palette. Preserve the original warmth and wide rounded face.
